ideas.pitch: An offline AI code reviewer optimized for student project submissions that runs locally on Snapdragon hardware to ensure submission privacy and zero cloud latency.
ideas.title: CampusNPU-Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of deploying on edge hardware and addresses a concrete logistical bottleneck for hackathon organizers evaluating hundreds of projects offline.

ideas.pitch: A BPMN-orchestrated pre-deployment risk diagnosis tool for student cloud deployments, integrating human-in-the-loop approvals for university server resource allocation.
ideas.title: BPMN-Campus-Risk
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages workflow orchestration and governance patterns proven successful in UiPath AgentHack submissions, appealing to academic IT administrators.

ideas.pitch: A training-free, self-improving semantic router that classifies student queries about university timetables and exams, continuously upgrading accuracy via LLM-judge feedback.
ideas.title: Semantic-Syllabus-Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the exact architecture of a Superlinked × Qwen hackathon winner to solve a campus administration pain point that judges experience daily.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous data incident response agent with an evidence gate and verified repair for student-managed university club databases and data pipelines.
ideas.title: DataHub-Campus-Lineage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the architectural rigor of a DataHub Agent Hackathon grand prize winner, focusing on verifiable automated data remediation.

ideas.pitch: Two identical AI grading agents that evaluate student assignments via adversarial debate to surface hidden plagiarism and logic flaws without pre-programmed rubrics.
ideas.title: Adversarial-Peer-Review
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the self-improving adversarial agent architecture that won Datadog's hackathon, showcasing genuinely hard multi-agent engineering.
